title: Tetairoa McMillan: I felt pretty weak last season, focused on getting my power back

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tetairoa McMillan: I felt pretty weak last season, focused on getting my power back
sources.description: There's been speculation in recent weeks about the Panthers using their first-round pick on a wide receiver and they'd be hoping for the same kind of results they got when they added a wideout at the top of the draft in 2025.
